import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class State {
        int cost;
        int r;
        int c;
        State(int cost, int r, int c) {
            this.cost = cost;
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int src, dest, capacity, flow;
        Edge(int src, int dest, int capacity, int flow) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dest = dest;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static final int MAXN = 500;

    static boolean[][] grid = new boolean[11][11];
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new List[MAXN];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] pt = new int[MAXN];
    static int size, exit_r, exit_c, time_limit;
    static int[][] steps = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] caps = new int[11][11];

    static int bfs_distance(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        Queue<State> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new State(0, x1, y1));
        int[][] dist_map = new int[11][11];
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 11; j++)
                dist_map[i][j] = INF;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            State cur = q.poll();
            int cost = cur.cost;
            int r = cur.r;
            int c = cur.c;
            dist_map[r][c] = cost;
            if (r > 0 && grid[r-1][c]) {
                int nr = r-1, nc = c;
                if (dist_map[nr][nc] > cost + 1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nr == x2 && nc == y2 && steps[nr][nc] >= cost + 1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nr == x2 && nc == y2) && steps[nr][nc] > cost + 1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2)
                        q.offer(new State(cost + 1, nr, nc));
                }
            }
            if (c > 0 && grid[r][c-1]) {
                int nr = r, nc = c-1;
                if (dist_map[nr][nc] > cost + 1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nr == x2 && nc == y2 && steps[nr][nc] >= cost + 1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nr == x2 && nc == y2) && steps[nr][nc] > cost + 1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2)
                        q.offer(new State(cost + 1, nr, nc));
                }
            }
            if (r < size-1 && grid[r+1][c]) {
                int nr = r+1, nc = c;
                if (dist_map[nr][nc] > cost + 1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nr == x2 && nc == y2 && steps[nr][nc] >= cost + 1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nr == x2 && nc == y2) && steps[nr][nc] > cost + 1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2)
                        q.offer(new State(cost + 1, nr, nc));
                }
            }
            if (c < size-1 && grid[r][c+1]) {
                int nr = r, nc = c+1;
                if (dist_map[nr][nc] > cost + 1) {
                    boolean cond1 = (nr == x2 && nc == y2 && steps[nr][nc] >= cost + 1);
                    boolean cond2 = (!(nr == x2 && nc == y2) && steps[nr][nc] > cost + 1);
                    if (cond1 || cond2)
                        q.offer(new State(cost + 1, nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
        return dist_map[x2][y2];
    }

    static void insert_edge(int s, int d, int cap) {
        edges.add(new Edge(s, d, cap, 0));
        edges.add(new Edge(d, s, 0, 0));
        adj[s].add(edges.size() - 2);
        adj[d].add(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean level_graph() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(0);
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1, (size * size * 2 + 2), -1);
        dist[0] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && dist[size * size * 2 + 1] == -1) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : adj[u]) {
                int v = edges.get(id).dest;
                if (dist[v] == -1 && edges.get(id).flow < edges.get(id).capacity) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[size * size * 2 + 1] != -1;
    }

    static int blocking_flow(int u, int bottleneck) {
        if (bottleneck == 0) return 0;
        if (u == size * size * 2 + 1) return bottleneck;
        for (; pt[u] < adj[u].size(); ++pt[u]) {
            int id = adj[u].get(pt[u]);
            int v = edges.get(id).dest;
            if (dist[v] != dist[u] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = blocking_flow(v, Math.min(bottleneck, edges.get(id).capacity - edges.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed != 0) {
                edges.get(id).flow += pushed;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int total = 0;
        while (level_graph()) {
            Arrays.fill(pt, 0, (size * size * 2 + 2), 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = blocking_flow(0, INF)) > 0)
                total += f;
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        size = sc.nextInt();
        time_limit = sc.nextInt();
        Queue<State> q = new LinkedList<>();
        char ch;
        int idx = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
                steps[i][j] = time_limit;
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    exit_r = i; exit_c = j;
                    grid[i][j] = false;
                } else if (ch == 'Y') {
                    grid[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    grid[i][j] = true;
                }
                insert_edge(0, idx++, (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - 48);
            }
        }
        idx = size * size + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') caps[i][j] = ch - 48;
                insert_edge(idx++, size * size * 2 + 1, (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - 48);
            }
        }
        q.offer(new State(0, exit_r, exit_c));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            State cur = q.poll();
            int cost = cur.cost;
            int r = cur.r;
            int c = cur.c;
            steps[r][c] = cost;
            if (r > 0 && cost + 1 < steps[r - 1][c] && grid[r - 1][c])
                q.offer(new State(cost + 1, r - 1, c));
            if (c > 0 && cost + 1 < steps[r][c - 1] && grid[r][c - 1])
                q.offer(new State(cost + 1, r, c - 1));
            if (r < size - 1 && cost + 1 < steps[r + 1][c] && grid[r + 1][c])
                q.offer(new State(cost + 1, r + 1, c));
            if (c < size - 1 && cost + 1 < steps[r][c + 1] && grid[r][c + 1])
                q.offer(new State(cost + 1, r, c + 1));
        }
        int node = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                int sink = size * size;
                node++;
                for (int x = 0; x < size; ++x) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < size; ++y) {
                        sink++;
                        if (grid[i][j] && grid[x][y] && bfs_distance(i, j, x, y) <= time_limit)
                            insert_edge(node, sink, INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dinic());
        sc.close();
    }
}
